summary: KLX Energy Services Holdings filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 confirming completion of a backstopped subscription rights offering that expired September 23, 2026, raising $37.2 million from 24,975,001 shares at $1.49 per whole share. Proceeds fund $31.0 million of general corporate purposes and $6.2 million to redeem 2030 Notes at par on October 10, 2026. Existing 2030 Noteholders backstopped $94.0 million via note-for-stock exchanges at par, reducing principal by $94.0 million and yielding about 105,677,168 shares outstanding after closing. Watch noteholder ownership overhang and the 30% pro forma cap.
